system.description:
This Charm defends against Sickness. When the Dragon-Blood or a patient is exposed to a disease or suffers its effects, she may roll (Intelligence + Medicine + Breeding) against a difficulty equal to the Sickness's Virulence. On a success, the illness is purged or prevented entirely. Sicknesses that do not have a listed Virulence rating cannot be negated with this Charm.

(Errata) A second purchase of this Charm allows it to be used against Poison as well, substituting the Poison's Toxicity for the Virulence difficulty.

(Errata) The Solar and Abyssal equivalent of this Charm is called Purifying Blood Ascendancy, which uses (Stamina + Resistance + Breeding) in place of (Intelligence + Medicine + Breeding).
